notes.title: Songs being removed when terminate contract bug fix
notes.content: * Songs from other bands are not removed when you terminate contract with bands.

notes.title: First Band Terminate Contract + Load Scout
notes.content:
* Fixed bug that when you terminate the contract with your first band you could not select the band from the slot on the right. 

* Fixed bug that when you load the game with a Scout Event on the calendar, the bands on the scout report were buggy.
